Key terms

Glossary

EMI
Equated Monthly Instalment — the fixed amount you pay each month, covering part principal and part interest.
APR
Annual Percentage Rate — the yearly cost of a loan including interest, expressed as a percentage.
Principal
The original amount borrowed, before interest is added.
Tenure
The total duration of the loan, usually stated in months.
Collateral
An asset pledged as security for a loan, which the lender can claim if you default.
Default
Failing to repay a loan according to the agreed terms.
Grace period
A set window after disbursement or a missed payment during which no penalty is charged.

Common questions

FAQ

How is my interest rate decided?+

Your rate depends on the loan product, requested amount, tenure, and your credit history. Shorter tenures and smaller amounts often carry lower rates.

Can I repay my loan early?+

Most Shohoj Rin partner products allow early repayment. Check the specific loan’s terms for any prepayment charges before applying.

What happens if I miss a payment?+

A short grace period usually applies before a late fee. Contact your lender early — many offer restructuring options rather than default.

Do I need collateral for every loan?+

No. Many personal, education, and emergency loans on Shohoj Rin are collateral-free, though larger business loans may require security.
